newsitem.title: USA: Hain, Weight Watchers in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Hain, Weight Watchers in marketing pact.

text.p: Hain Food Group Inc said Monday it had agreed with Weight Watchers Gourmet Food Co, a subsidiary of H.J. Heinz Co, to manufacture, market and sell certain Weight Watchers food products that had sales of about $17 million in the past 12 months.

Terms of the agreement were not disclosed. But the company said Heinz will share in operating profits of the products and Hain will issue warrants to Heinz to acquire up to 250,000 shares of its stock at prices ranging from $7 to $9 per share.

The agreement, which includes a license arrangement, said the company, provides that Hain will assume responsibility for the products, which are sold in supermarkets and other food establishments throughout the U.S. and Puerto Rico.

The line includes salad dressings, canned soups, sauces, cookies and snacks, grated cheese, mayonnaise and margarine. The initial license period is for five years, and is renewable under for additional five year periods. Subject to the completion of documentation, the company said the transaction is expected to close about April 1.
